name: North Adelaide
objection: Wikivoyage gives North Adelaide its own section and visitors base there; a stroll through its streets is a half-hour+ visit.

name: Adelaide Park Lands
objection: A ring of ordinary city parks, and its notable parts (Botanic Garden, Himeji, Elder Park) overlap.

name: Bicentennial Conservatory
objection: Sits inside the Botanic Garden, so could be seen as part of a larger spot.

name: North Terrace
objection: The street is the classic Adelaide cultural walk, named by two sources; but a duplicate of its institutions.

name: Migration Museum
objection: One counted source only, small museum.

name: Tandanya National Aboriginal Cultural Institute
objection: One source; modest visit.

name: State Library of South Australia
objection: Rule 2 negative benchmark (Tūranga); the Mortlock Wing interior is a genuine heritage draw.

name: Montefiore Hill
objection: Short stop (about 15 min), but guide-named lookout.

name: St Peter's Cathedral
objection: A church; one source.

name: St Francis Xavier's Cathedral
objection: Open daily next to Victoria Square; cathedral architecture.

name: Australian Space Discovery Centre
objection: Free public exhibit and distinct from other museums; one source and small.

name: Adelaide Holocaust Museum
objection: Real museum, $10 entry; limited hours and one source.

name: Old Parliament House
objection: Real museum open to the public; sources unverified.

name: Parliament House
objection: Tours exist, though the rule fails civic buildings.

name: Victoria Square
objection: Heart of the city grid; ten-minute look.

name: Chinatown, Adelaide
objection: Named by a guide; essentially restaurants.

name: Ayers House
objection: Genuine museum with tours; need a counted source.

name: Torrens Lake and Elder Park
objection: Popular riverside promenade.

name: JamFactory
objection: Public glassblowing tours and gallery vs shop/studio.

name: Carrick Hill
objection: Suburban location, limited days.

name: Penfolds Magill Estate
objection: Penfolds' founding site (Grange); arguably a landmark estate.

name: Coopers Brewery
objection: Iconic Adelaide brand with a visitor centre vs a company site.

name: Army Museum of South Australia
objection: Public museum; narrow hours and niche.

name: Port Adelaide
objection: Could be a wrapper around its own museums; the proposer decides whether it is a spot or a destination.

name: Port Adelaide Lighthouse
objection: Case for: a named landmark in a visitor guide. Against: lit Saturdays only, a short exterior look, part of the Port Adelaide precinct.

name: South Australian Aviation Museum
objection: One counted source only; Port Adelaide has several museums and this is a niche one.

name: Port Adelaide Historical Society Museum
objection: Case for: a counted source and a free-ish indoor stop. Against: small local museum with Port Adelaide's larger Maritime and Railway museums beside it; opening hours limited.

name: Semaphore Beach
objection: Overlaps the Semaphore suburb as a place; it is the same stop, so list once.

name: Tennyson Dunes
objection: Short, local-feeling reserve; two counted sources and a half-hour walk carry it.

name: Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary National Park
Thompson Beach
objection: Case for: samphire coast, shorebird migration. Against: Wikivoyage entry is thin; sits inside the Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary and may be part of that park's spot.

name: Glenelg Jetty
objection: Case for: the classic Glenelg promenade stop. Against: near-duplicate of Glenelg/Glenelg Beach, which is listed elsewhere.

name: Bay Discovery Centre
objection: Case for: indoor museum of the bay's history, half hour or more. Against: one source, small local museum.

name: The Beachouse
objection: Case for: a permanent family attraction on the Glenelg foreshore. Against: a commercial amusement operator with one source, ordinary child attractions.

name: Brighton
objection: Case for: one of Adelaide's well-known swimming beaches. Against: only a transport mention and a fishing-jetty line.

name: Marino Conservation Park
objection: Case for: counted source, clifftop walk with sea views. Against: small local reserve, little else names it.

name: Hallett Cove Beach
objection: Case for: second-tier beach and the Conservation Park's glacial features nearby. Against: the draw is the Hallett Cove Conservation Park, likely listed separately; beach alone is a transport mention.

name: Port Noarlunga
objection: Case for: classic snorkel jetty and beach. Against: no counted source here beyond transport.

name: Sturt Gorge Recreation Park
objection: Case for: a counted agency page, bushwalking close to the city. Against: local recreation park, no guide singles it out.

name: Glenthorne National Park
objection: Newly created, limited facilities; the visit may be short.

name: Warriparinga
objection: Case for: a cultural site visitors can enter. Against: no counted source, local focus.

name: Para Wirra Conservation Park
objection: Case for: a large park with trails an hour from the city. Against: one agency page and no guide singling it out.

name: Classic Jets Fighter Museum
objection: Case for: indoor museum, 1-2 hours. Against: one source, closed Tuesdays, niche.

name: National Military Vehicle Museum
objection: Case for: a real museum of military vehicles. Against: a bare listing, one source.

name: Tramway Museum, St Kilda
objection: Case for: tram rides, a half-day visit. Against: opens limited days and has no counted source.

name: St Kilda Mangrove Trail
objection: Case for: a walk through Barker Inlet mangroves. Against: short boardwalk, no counted source.

name: Gorge Wildlife Park
objection: One counted source only and a modest park; fire-damaged in 2019 so check it still trades.

name: Waterfall Gully
objection: Overlaps First Falls and the track to Mount Lofty; but it is the named base of the falls.

name: Waterfall Gully to Mount Lofty Summit Track
objection: For: Adelaide's best-known hill walk; against: overlaps Waterfall Gully and Mount Lofty Summit, source thin.

name: Old Government House, Belair
objection: For: heritage house a guide lists; against: only twice a month and inside Belair National Park.

name: Kuitpo Forest
objection: For: a large forest with named trails 45 min from Adelaide; against: one source, mostly pine plantation.

name: Mount Barker Summit
objection: One counted source and a short visit; lookouts on a track are usually parts, but here the summit is the stop.

name: Hans Heysen Art Studio
objection: Entries differ in name (The Cedars / Art Studio) but are one place; confirm hours.

name: Hahndorf Farm Barn
objection: For: genuine family attraction; against: one source and a commercial farm business.

name: Lobethal
objection: For: a named Hills town with its own heritage; against: the main draw is a seasonal event and no source names a permanent sight.

name: Lobethal Bushland Park
objection: One counted source, a local reserve; may fail as an ordinary suburban-style park.

name: National Motor Museum
objection: Pure car-fan appeal and a detour from Adelaide.

name: Jurlique Farm
objection: Brand-owned business with a retail store; one operator, not obviously a place in its own right.

name: Kaurna Trail
objection: One counted source, a route of stops rather than one place; no coordinates and it may overlap other city spots.
